description.narrative: Insatsen är en uppföljning av tidigare berett stöd. Den syftar till att öka den omedelbara effektiviteten av UNDPs arbete i konfliktländer genom investeringar i programmatiska och organisatoriska förändringar.

The support is follow-up of previous cooperation periods, and aims at increasing the immediate efficiency of UNDP's Conflict Prevention and Recovery (CPR) work though investments in programmatic and organizational changes

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2014Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: The outcome of the program is: "To preserve and advance human development by supporting the strengthening of national and local capacities to prevent, mitigate and recover from the effects of conflicts in priority countries". It is a very broadly formulated outcome, which the program works fully in line with.
Below are some of the results achieved within the different outputs: -The UNDP Early Warning Early Action pilot system finalised. Discussions initiated to start implementation on country-level. - 837 000 new emergency and long-term jobs (49% female) created and an additional 13,65 million people (42% women) benefitted from strengthened livelihoods in crisis-affected settings. -Improved income and employment opportunities for men and women in 313 villages in Myanmar's 7 border or ethnic states. - Imeadiate support to Country Offices in Phillipines, Central African Republic and Ukraine to boost capacity for crisis response. -321 deployments to 63 countries/offices facilitated. -Established capacities in 10 countries to respond to an include populations, particularly marginalized groups, women and youth. -Facilitated New Deal Implementation in seven countries.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
